## About
Stonebriar Oil Change & Auto Service is the Frisco shop of North Texas Auto Services, with a sister location in Castle Hills in Lewisville. The goal is simple: give you an experience similar to what a dealership offers, for vehicles of all makes and models.
Neighbors keep coming back. One reviewer has trusted the shop with all of their vehicles for several years, including a very old car the team keeps running. Another named Kevin and his team as their new go-to, and a third thanked Ryan Ortiz for keeping them updated through the whole visit.
We're open Monday through Saturday. Request an appointment and we'll reach out to confirm the details.

## Services
- Engine oil change: Routine oil service for your daily driver. One customer heading out on a road trip said the team brought in an extra associate to get him on his way.
- Tires and wheels: Tire and wheel work when you need it.
- A/C tune up: Keep your air conditioning working through the North Texas heat.
- Water pump: One customer had their water pump replaced and said the team held the car indoors when they needed more time to pick it up.
- Door lock: One reviewer had the driver side door lock fixed the same day.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: We service vehicles of all makes and models at our Frisco and Lewisville shops.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. Saturday hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: How does booking an appointment work?
A: Send us your preferred date and time. That slot may not always be open, so we'll contact you to confirm your actual appointment.
